newsitem.title: USA: Northland Cranberries, Ocean Spray settle suit.
newsitem.headline: Northland Cranberries, Ocean Spray settle suit.

text.p: Northland Cranberries Inc and Ocean Spray Cranberries Inc said Wednesday they settled litigation that was pending in Kenosha County Circuit Court concerning the 1996 cranberry crop from Koller Cranberry Co.
Northland acquired the Koller marsh in Vilas County, Wis., in July 1996 from Koller, which is an Ocean Spray cooperative member.

Under the settlement, Northland had agreed to pay to Ocean Spray the 50 percent liquidated damages provided for in the Ocean Spray cooperative marketing agreement with Koller. The amount of the payment was not immediately available.
Northland, however, will retain the 1996 cranberry crop harvested from the Koller marsh.
The suit had been brought by Ocean Spray against Northland.

The payment in the settlement stems from a provision in the Koller-Ocean Spray contract, which calls for a payment equal to half the average cranberry price for the past three years in the event the crop is not delivered.
Northland also agreed that, should it in the future acquire a property covered by an Ocean Spray marketing agreement, Northland will deliver the crop from that year to Ocean Spray.
The parties further agreed that a court order would be entered to require Northland to delivery the crop should it violate any future commitment to Ocean Spray.
